gatingCallSites.how: git ls-files, then for each tracked TEXT file count regex `(?<![\w.-])(keel\.exe|keelw|keel)[ \t]+<verb>(?![\w-])` over the gating verbs (adoption-check, assured, audit, audit-adherence, audit-ci-runs, audit-history, check, check-engine, gate, guard, rules, suite, validate); alternation is longest-first so check-engine/audit-history/audit-adherence/audit-ci-runs never collapse into check/audit. Counts OCCURRENCES, not lines - a line with two invocations is two call sites. Literal \n/\r/\t escapes are normalised to a space first, so a call site embedded in a source string (`\nkeel validate` in view/control_structure.rs) is counted. BOTH NUMBERS: the same sweep WITHOUT the trailing word-boundary reports 445 live and 975 history. The 4/3 extra are English prose, not invocations - overwhelmingly 'keel gates every project the commit touches'. TRUST the bounded number published here; the naive one over-counts. EXCLUDES .tracking/ (recorded history, never rewritten).

pendingAlreadyShipped.unit: proposed Decisions whose code already ships
pendingAlreadyShipped.how: parse .engine/decisions/*.sysml: of the PROPOSED Decisions, those whose own `consequences` string contains one of the literal phrases ['the code ships', 'already ship', 'ships now', 'is built'] (case-insensitive). This is a PHRASE RULE over authored prose, not a reading, and it is imperfect in two named ways - publish the number only with this caveat. FALSE POSITIVE: d0355 matches on 'once their state chip says the change already ships', which is about the OTHER pending items, not about itself. FALSE NEGATIVE: d0345 says 'the retirement itself is pushed now', which means the same thing and is outside the phrase list. The two cancel in the COUNT (5 either way) but not in the LIST. Fix by widening the phrase list, never by re-reading prose into a different answer.

suiteTests.how: .keel/metrics/suite-receipt.toml (D0353, machine-local): `passed` + `failed`. The receipt counts the whole `cargo test --release --no-fail-fast` run, unit + integration + doc tests.

suiteHead.unit: short SHA the suite last ran against

suiteWallMinutes.unit: wall minutes of the most recent suite run
suiteWallMinutes.how: .keel/metrics/suite-receipt.toml (D0353, machine-local): mtime(./.keel/metrics/suite-1788715028.log) minus `at`. `at` is the run's START - keel-cli/src/suite.rs does `let started = now_secs(); let log = ...suite-{started}.log; ... at: started` - and the log is written as the run streams, so its mtime is the finish. This is WALL time. It is deliberately NOT the sum of the per-binary 'finished in' values in the log, which is test time and excludes compilation and the gaps between binaries.

decisionNeedEdges.unit: typed edges from a Decision to a Need / UseCase / SystemRequirement
decisionNeedEdges.how: walk every .sysml under .tracking/ and .engine/. Build name -> type from declarations `<name> : (Need|UseCase|SystemRequirement) {` (the keyword varies - `requirement n... : Need`, `use case uc... : UseCase`), then count non-comment lines matching `#<Marker> dependency from d<NNNN> to <name>;` whose destination is in that map. Breakdown: Need=28, UseCase=3. FINDING: d0355's own consequences state 'no Decision in this repository is connected by any edge to a Need or UseCase' - this count contradicts that. The edges exist but are concentrated in two old clusters (d0094 -> the serve Needs, and the keel-viewer Needs); the claim is right in spirit for RECENT Decisions and wrong as written.
